description.zh:
需要绑定的alias。

Alias支持128个字节（一个中文字符算3个字节），当“UnbindAll”为”false”时该字段必填，一次最多解绑10个，多个alias用逗号分隔。
description.en:
The alias to detach.

An alias supports up to 128 bytes (one Chinese character counts as 3 bytes). This field is required when UnbindAll is false. You can detach up to 10 aliases at once. Separate multiple aliases with commas.

description.zh: 设备在推送的唯一标识，32位，数字和小写字母组合。
description.en: The unique device identifier for push notifications. It is 32 characters long and consists of digits and lowercase letters.

description.zh:
是否全部解绑，默认为”false”。

如果值为”true”，则解绑一个设备当前绑定的所有别名；如果值为”false”，则解绑”AliasName”指定的别名。
description.en:
Whether to detach all aliases. Default is false.

If true, detaches all aliases currently bound to the device. If false, detaches only the aliases specified in AliasName.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun push unbind-alias --app-key 23267207 --device-id e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000 --alias-name test_alias --unbind-all false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun push UnbindAlias --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceId e2ba19de97604f55b165576730000 --AppKey 23267207 --AliasName test_alias --UnbindAll false
